summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing the closing of a bought-deal public offering. The company issued 68,459,500 common shares at $0.84 per share for gross proceeds of $57,505,980, including full exercise of the over-allotment option. A syndicate co-led by Haywood Securities, ATB Cormark and National Bank Financial underwrote the deal, completed via a September 21, 2026 prospectus supplement to a February 23, 2026 base shelf. Net proceeds fund Springpole and Duparquet. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch TSX final approval.
